name: Kel Foncier
positioning: Land prospecting for French developers — which parcels can be built on, how much, and who owns them.
description: Kel Foncier combines cadastral parcels, local urban planning rules, building rights, ownership data, building permits and transactions into a mapping and search tool for property developers and land prospectors.
real_estate_use: A French development starts with a question the PLU answers slowly: on this parcel, what height, what footprint, what constraints. Kel Foncier makes that searchable in reverse — find every parcel in a commune with unused building rights above a threshold, filter out the protected ones, and get the owner. It compresses weeks of town-hall work into a query.
features: Cadastral parcels with local planning rules applied
Residual building rights calculation per parcel

use_cases.job: Find parcels with unused building rights in a target commune and identify the owners
Test the development potential of a site before making an offer
